decisions.reason: Finned tubes for air coolers are a core component that is cheap to keep and close to the established business. The product survived the 2019 portfolio cleanup that removed A–D, so keeping the option open is still justified.

Enhanced heat exchanger tubes build directly on the firm's tube expertise and cost little to keep on the market. They were still shown on their own page after other launches were dropped, so their value has not been ruled out.
